result.stdout:
Usage: man [options] [[[section] page]]

Display manual pages. Renders groff man pages to the terminal with colour and hyperlinks.

Options:
  --no-pager  Disable pager; write directly to stdout
  -w, --path  Print the file path of the page instead of rendering it
  --where     Print the file path of the page instead of rendering it (GNU compatibility alias for --path)
  --manpath   Print the effective man page search path and exit
  --width N   Render width in columns
  -h, --help  Show help
  --version   Show version
  --color     Force colored output
  --no-color  Disable colored output
  --json      JSON output
  --describe  Structured JSON metadata for AI agents

Exit Codes:
  0    Page found and displayed
  1    Page not found
  2    Usage error (bad arguments)
  125  Internal error (corrupt page or read failure)
